title: trix — where coding agents live
excerpt: A terminal workspace for coding agents. See which agent is working, which one needs you, and which one finished while you were looking elsewhere.
content_html:
trıx v1.1.5

⠹ a workspace where coding agents live · v1.1.5 is out →

Know which agent needs you.

Run Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Muse, Gemini, Antigravity, Amp, shells or any CLI agent side by side. trix shows you at a glance which one is working, which one is waiting on you, and which one finished while you were looking elsewhere.

$brew install leofle/trix/trix

get trix →

Arch or Omarchy? Use the pacman package ↓

⠹ 2 agents working

trix — ~/code

alt+a

That loop runs on its own: an agent asks for permission, the strip appears, alt+a takes you straight there.

The agent comes first.

tmux and zellij don't know anything about agents. trix is built around what each agent is doing.

⚓

Agents report in

Agents tell trix when you send a prompt, when they run a tool, when they need you and when they finish. trix doesn't scrape the screen to guess, and it never edits your agent configs.

▲

Never miss one that needs you

When an agent is waiting on you, a red bar drops over the pane you're in, and you get a desktop notification and a bell. A chime plays when work you haven't seen finishes.

⌥

One key to what matters

Press alt+a to jump to the agent that has waited on you the longest. If nothing is waiting, it takes you to finished work you haven't looked at yet.

▦

See every agent at once

Press alt+g to see your agents side by side, updating live. Agents waiting on you turn red, so you know where to look first.

⑂

Worktrees built in

Each agent can work in its own git worktree on its own branch, so agents running in parallel never overwrite each other's files.

↻

Close the window, keep the agents

Agents run in a background server. Close the terminal and they keep working. After a crash or a reboot, each one resumes the conversation it was in.

Also: search across every agent, one prompt to many agents, a context gauge, layouts, named sessions and 23 themes. Full feature list ↗

Bring your agent.

trix starts each agent itself and hands it what it needs, so your configs stay untouched. If you don't have an agent yet, its pane installs it the first time you start it.

claude codex grok opencode cursor copilot muse gemini antigravity amp any CLI

How each agent reports its state ↗

Five states, one glance.

Hover a state to see it. The mascot's antenna uses the same colors the sidebar does.

⠹workingprompt submitted, tools running, or sustained output

▲needs youpermission request, a question, or an approval prompt on screen

✓donethe turn finished, or work went quiet

○idlesitting at the prompt

•unseenfinished or asked something while you were elsewhere

Agents can run agents.

A script, or an agent in another pane, can start agents, send them prompts, wait for them and read what they did. trix never answers a permission prompt for you.

$ trix spawn claude --name api --worktree \

--prompt "add rate limiting to /login"

api ~/code/web/.trix/worktrees/api

$ trix send api "also cover it with a test"

sent to api

$ trix wait api # blocks until api stops working

api done turn finished

$ trix read api -n 80 # its last 80 lines

$ trix ls --json # state, activity, branch, diff…

AGENTS 3

1⠹lead4m02s

Bash trix wait api auth -t 280

claude ▁▂▁▁▁▂▁▁ main

2⠹api‹lead1m37s

Edit src/limit.rs

claude ▅▇▅▃▅▇▆▃ trix/api

3✓auth•‹lead12s

turn finished

claude ▅▃▂▁▁▁▁▁ trix/auth

lead → api: also cover it with a test

All agent control commands ↗

All on alt.

Every other key goes straight to the focused agent. alt+? shows the full list, and any key can be rebound.

alt+nnew agent

alt+anext agent that needs you

alt+1…9alt+j/kjump / next / previous

alt+ggrid ⇄ focus

alt+bsend a prompt to many agents

alt+fsearch every agent's scrollback

alt+ddetach (agents keep running)

alt+,settings

What's new.

The latest releases, read from GitHub. All releases ↗

  • Yes/no dialogs take tab and the mouse #55
  • trix args: change the flags an agent starts with, from any shell #54
  • Copilot reads trix's workspace instructions, so it can see its peers #53

Get it running.

Runs on Linux and macOS. Other ways to install ↗

Latest: v1.1.5 (Nov 15, 2026). brew upgrade trix gets it; on Arch, run the pacman line again.

$ brew install leofle/trix/trix

# Arch-based distros only (Arch, Omarchy, EndeavourOS, Manjaro…), x86_64 / aarch64:

$ curl -fLO https://github.com/leofle/trix/releases/latest/download/trix-$(uname -m).pkg.tar.zst && sudo pacman -U ./trix-$(uname -m).pkg.tar.zst

$ trix # open the workspace, or attach to the running one

$ trix claude codex shell # …and start these agents in the current folder

$ trix ls # agents and states, without attaching

On a Mac, set your terminal's Option key to send Alt, since every trix key is alt+…. How, per terminal ↗

Codex, Gemini, Antigravity and Amp need a one-time setup to show full detail. See the README ↗

Everything else.

The README covers the rest.
